name: Coromandel Café & Artisanal Kitchen
description: Exquisite European & French cuisine served in an art-filled 19th-century French mansion with an organic produce focus.
eco_practice: Direct farm-sourced heirloom vegetables and zero plastic packaging.

name: Café des Arts
description: Bohemian colonial café with vintage posters and hibiscus gardens serving wholesome French crêpes, baguettes, and organic coffees.
eco_practice: Fair-trade shade-grown coffee and upcycled colonial furniture.

name: Surguru Spot
description: Legendary South Indian vegetarian dining offering authentic crispy ghee roast dosas, idlis, and traditional filter kaapi.
eco_practice: Traditional banana leaf dining and 100% plant-based local ingredients.

name: Tanto Pizzeria (Auroville)
description: Wood-fired artisanal pizzas baked using stone ovens, handmade mozzarella, and fresh organic herbs picked straight from Auroville farms.
eco_practice: Solar-supplemented ovens and 100% compostable bio-waste stream.

name: Crepe in Touch
description: Charming quiet courtyard eatery specializing in gluten-free buckwheat galettes, sweet crêpes, and fresh iced herbal infusions.
eco_practice: Gluten-free traditional buckwheat sourcing and chemical-free tea blends.

name: Maison Perumal Restaurant
description: Slow-cooked authentic Tamil-French fusion recipes highlighting freshly caught seafood and regional Chettinad spices.
eco_practice: Sustainable local fishery partnership and native grain promotion.
